name: computer-connect-ux
title: Computer connect UX: auto-refresh after connect + multi-computer connect dialog
description: Two frontend fixes on the Computer page: (1) after connecting a computer (daemon), the page must refresh automatically instead of requiring a manual reload; (2) when a computer is already connected on the current server, the create/connect flow should show a dialog offering to keep the current connection, while still allowing creation when the server connects from another machine.
